Grafana Monitoring Setup Guide

Complete Terraform & SSL Configuration

This guide will help you set up a complete monitoring infrastructure with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and SSL-secured domains using Terraform on AWS.

Prerequisites

  • AWS Account - An active Amazon Web Services account
  • AWS CLI - Installed and configured with your credentials
  • Terraform - Version 1.0 or higher installed
  • Domain Name - A registered domain that you can configure DNS records for
  • SSH Key Pair - An existing EC2 Key Pair in your AWS region

Step 1: Create Project Structure

Create a new directory for your project and the necessary file structure:

mkdir grafana-monitoring-terraform cd grafana-monitoring-terraform # Create empty files touch main.tf variables.tf outputs.tf user_data.sh

Step 2: Create Configuration Files

2.1 variables.tf

Define your environment variables. ACTION REQUIRED Replace the default values with your own details.

variable "aws_region" { description = "AWS region to deploy resources" type = string default = "ap-south-1" } variable "key_name" { description = "Name of your existing EC2 Key Pair" type = string default = "your-key-pair-name" } variable "instance_type" { description = "EC2 instance type for monitoring server" type = string default = "t2.medium" } variable "monitoring_server_name" { description = "Name tag for the monitoring server" type = string default = "Grafana-Monitoring-Server" } variable "uat_domain" { description = "UAT environment domain (e.g., grafana.uat.example.com)" type = string default = "grafana.uat.example.com" } variable "live_domain" { description = "Production environment domain (e.g., grafana.live.example.com)" type = string default = "grafana.live.example.com" } variable "ssl_email" { description = "Email for Let's Encrypt SSL certificate notifications" type = string default = "admin@example.com" }

2.2 main.tf

This file defines the VPC, Security Groups, and EC2 instance resources.

terraform { required_version = ">= 1.0" required_providers { aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 5.0" } } } provider "aws" { region = var.aws_region } # Get the latest Ubuntu 22.04 AMI data "aws_ami" "ubuntu" { most_recent = true owners = ["099720109477"] # Canonical filter { name = "name" values = ["ubuntu/images/hvm-ssd/ubuntu-jammy-22.04-amd64-server-*"] } filter { name = "virtualization-type" values = ["hvm"] } } # VPC Configuration resource "aws_vpc" "main" { cidr_block = "10.20.0.0/16" enable_dns_hostnames = true enable_dns_support = true tags = { Name = "Monitoring-VPC" } } # Internet Gateway resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" { vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id tags = { Name = "Monitoring-IGW" } } # Public Subnet resource "aws_subnet" "public" { vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id cidr_block = "10.20.1.0/24" availability_zone = "${var.aws_region}a" map_public_ip_on_launch = true tags = { Name = "Monitoring-Public-Subnet" } } # Route Table resource "aws_route_table" "public" { vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id route { cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0" gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id } tags = { Name = "Monitoring-Public-RT" } } # Route Table Association resource "aws_route_table_association" "public" { subnet_id = aws_subnet.public.id route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id } # Security Group for Monitoring Server resource "aws_security_group" "monitoring" { name = "monitoring-server-sg" description = "Security group for Grafana monitoring server" vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id # SSH access ingress { description = "SSH" from_port = 22 to_port = 22 protocol = "tcp" cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] } # HTTP for Let's Encrypt ingress { description = "HTTP" from_port = 80 to_port = 80 protocol = "tcp" cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] } # HTTPS ingress { description = "HTTPS" from_port = 443 to_port = 443 protocol = "tcp" cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] } # Grafana ingress { description = "Grafana" from_port = 3000 to_port = 3000 protocol = "tcp" cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] } # Prometheus ingress { description = "Prometheus" from_port = 9090 to_port = 9090 protocol = "tcp" cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] } # Node Exporter ingress { description = "Node Exporter" from_port = 9100 to_port = 9100 protocol = "tcp" cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] } # Loki ingress { description = "Loki" from_port = 3100 to_port = 3100 protocol = "tcp" cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] } # All outbound traffic egress { from_port = 0 to_port = 0 protocol = "-1" cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] } tags = { Name = "Monitoring-Server-SG" } } # EC2 Instance for Monitoring Server resource "aws_instance" "monitoring_server" { ami = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id instance_type = var.instance_type key_name = var.key_name subnet_id = aws_subnet.public.id vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.monitoring.id] user_data = templatefile("${path.module}/user_data.sh", { uat_domain = var.uat_domain live_domain = var.live_domain ssl_email = var.ssl_email }) root_block_device { volume_size = 30 volume_type = "gp3" } tags = { Name = var.monitoring_server_name } }

2.3 outputs.tf

Displays connection info after deployment.

output "monitoring_server_public_ip" { description = "Public IP address of the monitoring server" value = aws_instance.monitoring_server.public_ip } output "monitoring_server_private_ip" { description = "Private IP address of the monitoring server" value = aws_instance.monitoring_server.private_ip } output "grafana_direct_access" { description = "Direct access to Grafana (before DNS setup)" value = "http://${aws_instance.monitoring_server.public_ip}:3000" } output "next_steps" { description = "Next steps after deployment" value = <<-EOT NEXT STEPS: =========== 1. Configure DNS Records: - Add A record: ${var.uat_domain} -> ${aws_instance.monitoring_server.public_ip} - Add A record: ${var.live_domain} -> ${aws_instance.monitoring_server.public_ip} 2. Wait 5-10 minutes for the server to complete setup 3. SSH into the server to check progress: ssh -i your-key.pem ubuntu@${aws_instance.monitoring_server.public_ip} 4. Check setup logs: tail -f /var/log/cloud-init-output.log 5. Once DNS propagates, access your dashboards: - UAT: https://${var.uat_domain} - LIVE: https://${var.live_domain} 6. Default Grafana credentials: - Username: admin - Password: admin EOT }

2.4 user_data.sh

This bash script automates the installation of Docker, Nginx, Certbot, and the deployment of the Grafana stack.

#!/bin/bash # Exit on any error set -e # Log all output exec > >(tee /var/log/user-data.log) exec 2>&1 echo "=== Starting Monitoring Server Setup ===" echo "Timestamp: $(date)" # Update system echo "=== Updating system packages ===" apt-get update -y apt-get upgrade -y # Install required packages echo "=== Installing Docker and dependencies ===" apt-get install -y \ docker.io \ docker-compose \ nginx \ certbot \ python3-certbot-nginx \ curl \ git # Start and enable Docker systemctl start docker systemctl enable docker usermod -aG docker ubuntu # Create monitoring directory echo "=== Creating monitoring directory structure ===" mkdir -p /home/ubuntu/monitoring cd /home/ubuntu/monitoring # Create docker-compose.yml echo "=== Creating Docker Compose configuration ===" cat > docker-compose.yml <<'EOF' version: '3.8' services: node-exporter: image: prom/node-exporter:v1.8.1 container_name: node-exporter restart: unless-stopped volumes: - /proc:/host/proc:ro - /sys:/host/sys:ro - /:/rootfs:ro command: - '--path.procfs=/host/proc' - '--path.sysfs=/host/sys' - '--path.rootfs=/rootfs' - '--collector.filesystem.mount-points-exclude=^/(sys|proc|dev|host|etc)($$|/)' ports: - "9100:9100" prometheus: image: prom/prometheus:v2.53.0 container_name: prometheus restart: unless-stopped ports: - "9090:9090" volumes: - ./prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml loki: image: grafana/loki:3.1.0 container_name: loki restart: unless-stopped ports: - "3100:3100" command: -config.file=/etc/loki/local-config.yaml volumes: - /home/ubuntu/monitoring/loki-data:/loki - /home/ubuntu/monitoring/loki-local-config.yaml:/etc/loki/local-config.yaml promtail: image: grafana/promtail:3.1.0 container_name: promtail restart: unless-stopped volumes: - /var/log:/var/log - ./promtail-config.yml:/etc/promtail/config.yml command: -config.file=/etc/promtail/config.yml grafana: image: grafana/grafana:11.1.0 container_name: grafana restart: unless-stopped ports: - "3000:3000" volumes: - /home/ubuntu/monitoring/grafana-data:/var/lib/grafana - ./grafana.ini:/etc/grafana/grafana.ini environment: - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin - GF_SECURITY_ALLOW_EMBEDDING=true - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=true - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ORG_ROLE=Viewer EOF # Create Prometheus configuration echo "=== Creating Prometheus configuration ===" cat > prometheus.yml <<'EOF' global: scrape_interval: 15s scrape_configs: - job_name: prometheus static_configs: - targets: ['localhost:9090'] - job_name: node-exporter static_configs: - targets: ['node-exporter:9100'] EOF # Create Loki configuration echo "=== Creating Loki configuration ===" cat > loki-local-config.yaml <<'EOF' auth_enabled: false server: http_listen_port: 3100 grpc_listen_port: 9096 common: path_prefix: /loki storage: filesystem: chunks_directory: /loki/chunks rules_directory: /loki/rules replication_factor: 1 ring: instance_addr: 127.0.0.1 kvstore: store: inmemory schema_config: configs: - from: 2024-01-01 store: tsdb object_store: filesystem schema: v13 index: prefix: index_ period: 24h limits_config: reject_old_samples: true reject_old_samples_max_age: 168h EOF # Create Promtail configuration echo "=== Creating Promtail configuration ===" cat > promtail-config.yml <<'EOF' server: http_listen_port: 9080 grpc_listen_port: 0 positions: filename: /tmp/positions.yaml clients: - url: http://loki:3100/loki/api/v1/push scrape_configs: - job_name: system static_configs: - targets: - localhost labels: job: varlogs __path__: /var/log/*log EOF # Create Grafana configuration echo "=== Creating Grafana configuration ===" cat > grafana.ini <<'EOF' [server] protocol = http http_port = 3000 [security] admin_user = admin admin_password = admin allow_embedding = true [auth.anonymous] enabled = true org_role = Viewer [users] allow_sign_up = false EOF # Create data directories and permissions mkdir -p grafana-data loki-data chown -R 10001:10001 loki-data chown -R 472:472 grafana-data chown -R ubuntu:ubuntu /home/ubuntu/monitoring # Start Docker containers echo "=== Starting Docker containers ===" docker-compose up -d # Wait for services to start echo "=== Waiting for services to initialize ===" sleep 30 # Create nginx configuration for temporary HTTP access echo "=== Creating temporary Nginx configuration ===" cat > /etc/nginx/sites-available/grafana-temp <<EOF server { listen 80; server_name ${uat_domain} ${live_domain}; location ~ /.well-known/acme-challenge/ { allow all; root /var/www/html; } location / { proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000; proxy_set_header Host \$host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP \$remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For \$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto \$scheme; } } EOF # Enable temporary configuration ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/grafana-temp /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/grafana-temp rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx # Create webroot for Let's Encrypt mkdir -p /var/www/html echo "=== Waiting for DNS propagation ===" # Get server's public IP PUBLIC_IP=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/public-ipv4) # Function to check DNS resolution check_dns() { local domain=$1 local resolved_ip=$(dig +short $domain | tail -n1) if [ "$resolved_ip" = "$PUBLIC_IP" ]; then echo "✓ $domain resolves correctly to $PUBLIC_IP" return 0 else echo "✗ $domain does not resolve to $PUBLIC_IP (got: $resolved_ip)" return 1 fi } # Wait up to 10 minutes for DNS propagation MAX_WAIT=600 ELAPSED=0 INTERVAL=30 while [ $ELAPSED -lt $MAX_WAIT ]; do if check_dns "${uat_domain}" && check_dns "${live_domain}"; then echo "=== DNS propagation complete! ===" break fi echo "Waiting for DNS propagation... ($ELAPSED/$MAX_WAIT seconds)" sleep $INTERVAL ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED + INTERVAL)) done if [ $ELAPSED -ge $MAX_WAIT ]; then echo "⚠ Warning: DNS propagation timeout. SSL setup will be skipped." echo "Please run the SSL setup manually after DNS propagates." else # Obtain SSL certificates echo "=== Obtaining SSL certificates ===" certbot certonly --webroot \ -w /var/www/html \ -d ${uat_domain} \ --non-interactive \ --agree-tos \ --email ${ssl_email} || echo "Failed to obtain certificate for ${uat_domain}" certbot certonly --webroot \ -w /var/www/html \ -d ${live_domain} \ --non-interactive \ --agree-tos \ --email ${ssl_email} || echo "Failed to obtain certificate for ${live_domain}" # Create final Nginx configuration with SSL echo "=== Creating final Nginx configuration with SSL ===" cat > /etc/nginx/sites-available/grafana <<EOF # HTTP server: Redirects both domains to HTTPS server { listen 80; server_name ${uat_domain} ${live_domain}; location ~ /.well-known/acme-challenge/ { allow all; root /var/www/html; } location / { return 301 https://\$host\$request_uri; } } # UAT HTTPS Server server { listen 443 ssl; server_name ${uat_domain}; ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/${uat_domain}/fullchain.pem; ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/${uat_domain}/privkey.pem; location / { proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000; proxy_set_header Host \$host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP \$remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For \$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto \$scheme; } } # LIVE HTTPS Server server { listen 443 ssl; server_name ${live_domain}; ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/${live_domain}/fullchain.pem; ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/${live_domain}/privkey.pem; location / { proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000; proxy_set_header Host \$host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP \$remote_addr; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For \$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto \$scheme; } } EOF # Switch to SSL configuration rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/grafana-temp ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/grafana /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/grafana nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx echo "=== SSL setup complete! ===" fi # Enable Nginx on boot systemctl enable nginx echo "=== Setup Complete ==="

Step 3: Configure DNS Records

Before deploying, or immediately after, create A records in your DNS provider pointing to your server's public IP:

  • grafana.uat.example.com → Server Public IP
  • grafana.live.example.com → Server Public IP

Step 4: Deploy Infrastructure

# Initialize Terraform terraform init # Review Plan terraform plan # Deploy (Type 'yes' when prompted) terraform apply

Wait 5-10 minutes for the server to install all software.

Step 5: Verify & Access

1. Get your IP and instructions:

terraform output

2. Access Grafana (after DNS propagation):

  • UAT: https://grafana.uat.example.com
  • LIVE: https://grafana.live.example.com

Default Credentials:

  • Username: admin
  • Password: admin

Architecture Components

Component Port Purpose
Grafana 3000 Dashboard & Visualization
Prometheus 9090 Metrics Collection
Loki 3100 Log Aggregation
Node Exporter 9100 System Metrics

Troubleshooting

Issue: DNS not resolving / SSL Failed

Wait longer for DNS propagation (up to 1 hour). If the script timed out, run Certbot manually via SSH:

sudo certbot certonly --webroot -w /var/www/html -d your.domain.com

Issue: Docker containers not running

SSH into the server and check container logs:

docker ps -a docker logs grafana

Cleanup

To remove all resources created by Terraform:

terraform destroy
